cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol(); coords=[]
def atom(el,pos,charge=0):
 a=Chem.Atom(el); a.SetNoImplicit(True);a.SetFormalCharge(charge)
 i=rw.AddAtom(a);coords.append(np.array(pos,dtype=float));return i
def bond(a,b,order=1):rw.AddBond(a,b,{1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE,3:Chem.BondType.TRIPLE,'d':Chem.BondType.DATIVE}[order])
# six-membered dearomatized pyridyl ring
pn=atom('N',(0,2.10,0),-1)
p1=atom('C',(-1.22,2.8,0));p2=atom('C',(-1.22,4.20,0));p3=atom('C',(0,4.9,0));p4=atom('C',(1.22,4.2,0));p5=atom('C',(1.22,2.8,0))
bond(pn,p1);bond(p1,p2);bond(p2,p3,2);bond(p3,p4);bond(p4,p5,2);bond(p5,pn)
lc=atom('C',(-2.49,2.23,0));bond(p1,lc,2)
ln1=atom('N',(-2.94,0.90,0));lcarb=atom('C',(-2.1,-0.17,0));ln2=atom('N',(-2.96,-1.23,0));lr1=atom('C',(-4.25,-0.77,0));lr2=atom('C',(-4.25,0.55,0))
bond(lc,ln1);bond(ln1,lcarb);bond(lcarb,ln2);bond(ln2,lr1);bond(lr1,lr2,2);bond(lr2,ln1)
rn1=atom('N',(2.13,1.65,0));rcarb=atom('C',(2.03,0.26,0));rn2=atom('N',(3.2,-0.23,0));rr1=atom('C',(4.08,0.81,0));rr2=atom('C',(3.43,2.0,0))
bond(p5,rn1);bond(rn1,rcarb);bond(rcarb,rn2);bond(rn2,rr1);bond(rr1,rr2,2);bond(rr2,rn1)
def mes(n,centerNHC):
 v=coords[n]-np.array(centerNHC);v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
 w=np.array([0,0,1.])
 origin=coords[n]+1.42*v; center=origin+1.40*v
 arr=[]
 for j in range(6):
  t=j*np.pi/3;pos=center+1.4*(-v*np.cos(t)+w*np.sin(t));arr.append(atom('C',pos))
 bond(n,arr[0])
 for j in range(6):bond(arr[j],arr[(j+1)%6],2 if j%2==0 else 1)
 for j in [1,3,5]:
  pos=coords[arr[j]];away=(pos-center)/1.4
  c=atom('C',pos+1.50*away);bond(arr[j],c)
mes(ln2,(-3.3,-0.14,0));mes(rn2,(2.96,0.90,0))
# Ruthenium(II), anionic pincer, hydride and two carbonyls
ru=atom('Ru',(0,0,0),2)
for donor in [pn,lcarb,rcarb]:bond(donor,ru,'d')
co1=atom('C',(0,-1.88,0));o1=atom('O',(0,-3.04,0));bond(co1,o1,3);bond(co1,ru,'d')
co2=atom('C',(0,0,1.88));o2=atom('O',(0,0,3.04));bond(co2,o2,3);bond(co2,ru,'d')
hyd=atom('H',(0,0,-1.60),-1);bond(hyd,ru,'d')
m=rw.GetMol()
# hydrogens on regular C sites, explicitly create proper count
nh={p2:1,p3:1,p4:1,lc:1,lr1:1,lr2:1,rr1:1,rr2:1}
# mes rings indices 17..25 and 26..34
for start in [17,26]:
 for j in [2,4]:nh[start+j]=1
 for j in [6,7,8]:nh[start+j]=3
for i,h in nh.items():m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetNumExplicitHs(h)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
c=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,x in enumerate(coords):c.SetAtomPosition(i,x)
m.AddConformer(c)
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'initial.mol')
xyz=Chem.MolToXYZBlock(m)
open('initial.xyz','w').write(xyz)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(), 'charge',Chem.GetFormalCharge(m));print(Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
PY
python build.py

cat > check.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('initial.mol',removeHs=False)
# Mol file includes explicit H all
lines=open('xtbopt.xyz').read().splitlines()[2:]
elem=[s.split()[0] for s in lines]; xyz=np.array([[float(t) for t in s.split()[1:4]] for s in lines])
for i in [0,8,13,36,38,40]:print('Ru-',i,elem[i],np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[35]))
print('hydride signed triple',np.linalg.det(np.stack([xyz[13]-xyz[35],xyz[0]-xyz[35],xyz[40]-xyz[35]])))
colors={'C':'#444444','H':'#bbbbbb','N':'blue','O':'red','Ru':'purple'}
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,7))
for ax,ab in zip(axs,[(0,1),(0,2)]):
 for b in m.GetBonds():
  i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
  ax.plot(xyz[[i,j],ab[0]],xyz[[i,j],ab[1]],c='#555',lw=1)
 for i,e in enumerate(elem):
  ax.scatter(*xyz[i,list(ab)],c=colors[e],s=45 if e!='H' else 15)
  if e!='H':ax.text(*xyz[i,list(ab)],f'{e}{i}',fontsize=8)
 ax.set_aspect('equal')
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('optimized.png',dpi=140)
PY
